notice: A content hash is not a signature and a passing check is not a proof of correctness; the receipt records what ran, under which limits, and what the sandbox reported.

acceptance.description: Two current approvals from eligible reviewers satisfy the normal quorum.
Actor membership and event tenant must match the change; a foreign author cannot authorize evaluation.
Inactive, revoked, ordinary-member, and unknown actors cannot supply approvals.
An author cannot approve their own change, including an administrator author.
Quorums of one through three require distinct reviewers; repeated events cannot inflate the count.
Other-change and stale-head events cannot authorize the change; stale change requests cannot veto it.
An eligible current request for changes blocks release even when other approvals satisfy the quorum.
A reviewer's latest current-head decision can withdraw an approval or replace a prior withdrawal or change request.
Only open changes with a present, active, unrevoked author are eligible.
Unknown statuses, malformed records, duplicate actor identities, ambiguous review sequences, and invalid quorums fail closed.
Sequence numbers, rather than record-list order, determine the latest current review.

plan.objective: Check the pure approval decision on bounded plain-data records. Do not infer authentication, production integration, whole-service correctness, or market demand from these results.
plan.prompt: Evaluate a simulated SaaS team's change approvals under the explicitly defined tenant, role, revision, and quorum policy. This is an internal example, not a customer trial.

result.note: Caller-supplied criteria; this receipt does not establish human approval or test quality.
